web/websocket-client.name: websocket-client
web/websocket-client.description: Resilient WebSocket client supporting heartbeat check, auto-reconnection, and buffered message outbox.
web/websocket-client.aiPromptContext: Use this block when building real-time connections (chat apps, dashboard telemetry streams, live notification listeners) that need resilient auto-recovery on unstable mobile or browser networks. Import using: import { ResilientWebSocket } from './web/websocket-client.js';

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The target ws:// or wss:// URL endpoint.

parameters.name: options.reconnectInterval
parameters.description: Starting reconnect delay in milliseconds.

parameters.name: options.heartbeatInterval
parameters.description: Time in milliseconds between ping packets.
